steps.hardClue: Throw a device outside the map to pull in the generator.
steps.clue: Throw a Gersh Device outside the map to pull in the generator.

steps.hardClue: Activate the glowing monitor beneath the stairs to reveal a triangular symbol.
steps.clue: Activate the glowing monitor beneath the stairs near the Lunar Lander.

steps.hardClue: Simultaneously press the buttons beside the four Perk Machines during a special round.
steps.clue: Simultaneously press the buttons beside the four Perk Machines during a Space Monkey round.

steps.hardClue: Stand on the pressure plate facing the clock for two minutes.
steps.clue: Stand on the pressure plate in the launch area and face the clock for two minutes.

steps.hardClue: Collect the four letters in the sky.
steps.clue: Collect the letters in the sky to spell L-U-N-A.

steps.hardClue: Use a device on the glowing orb, then attack it with several upgraded weapons.
steps.clue: Use a Gersh Device on the orb, then attack with upgraded Wonder Weapons and Matryoshka Dolls.
